title: Robert Jameson's targeting team called in to restart Oscar Flight missiles
summary: Robert Salas tells of Robert Jameson's targeting team called in to restart Oscar Flight missiles, about March 1967 at Malmstrom Air Force Base, Montana, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: I got a call saying a missile went off alert in Oscar flight.

plain: A former Air Force officer, Robert Salas, passes on the account of a man named Robert Jameson about March 1967 at Malmstrom Air Force Base in Montana, home to nuclear missiles. According to Salas, Jameson got a call saying a missile had gone off alert, meaning it could no longer be launched, in Oscar Flight, one group of missiles, and his targeting team was sent to get the missiles working again. Salas tells it because, if true, it supports the claim that a UFO shut down American nuclear weapons.
